name: Kokoro... 0
source:
Main character attempts a suicide on the street. But there a woman there who extends her hands to him and gives him energy to live. However, his dark past haunts him, and he starts to get interested in possessing bodies of people around him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公试图在街头自杀，一名女子却在那里向他伸出手，赋予他继续活下去的力量。然而，黑暗的过去依然纠缠着他，他也开始对占据身边之人的身体产生兴趣。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
